newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius share index down as leading stocks fall.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius share index down as leading stocks fall.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Mauritius share index, semdex, fell by 2.19 points to 313.87 on Wednesday amid declines in leading stocks, brokers said.
Turnover was posted at 9.07 million rupees on 561,316 shares from 2.59 million rupees on 196,893 shares on Monday.

Brokers blamed the lower semdex on falls in stocks of leading companies amid market uncertainty. "Market sentiment is not improving on the back of government uncertainty, the long absence of a finance minister and an EIU (Economist Intelligence Unit) report," a dealer said.

Earlier this week, the local media reported on an EIU country report which painted a subdued picture for the Indian Ocean island's future, with a lower economic growth forecast of 4 percent for 1997 as compared to 6 percent for 1996.
Shares of several leading companies fell on such news amid higher volume, "indicating market sentiment is not pointing towards the right direction," the dealer said.

Mauritius Commercial Bank lost one rupee to 71 on 12,711 shares but State Bank of Mauritius remained at 8.40 rupees on 25,600 shares. Mauritius Breweries rose 5 rupees to 125 on 27,424 shares. Mauritius Stationery Manufacturers lost 40 cents to 46 rupees on 317 shares.

Promotion And Development (PAD) was 50 cents down to 14.50 rupees on 650 shares. General Investment Development Company (GIDC) ordinary was unchanged at 5.40 rupees on 27,736 shares and GIDC preference fell 20 cents to 5.0.
